entries.summary: Add jquery-ui-sortable to admin script dependencies for floor reorder feature
Convention map deep link: fix oha_vendor param matching vendor_hub_id not vendor_id
entries.notes: checkDeepLink was comparing vendorSlug against b.vendor_id (GeoDirectory ID). Should be b.vendor_hub_id (vendor_application post ID). The PWA vendor cards use vendor_application IDs.

entries.summary: Convention map: show vendor name below booth number at zoom 12+ in pin label
entries.notes: booth-label layer text-field updated with step expression. Zoom 10-11 shows number only. Zoom 12+ shows number plus vendor name on two lines when both are present. text-max-width bumped to 12.

entries.summary: Booth placement: fix wrong coordinates when page is scrolled (clientX/Y to pageX/Y)
entries.notes: coordsFromEvent used clientX/clientY (viewport-relative) against offset() (document-relative). Scroll offset corrupted all placed booth positions. Also fixed touchend crash where touches[] is empty - now uses changedTouches.

entries.summary: Convention Settings: add Remove Floor button and drag-to-reorder for floor list
entries.notes: Uses jQuery UI Sortable (bundled with WP). reindexFloors() renumbers name/id attrs after sort or remove. Blocks remove if only one floor remains.

entries.summary: Created modern map plugin with region-based navigation
entries.notes: Initial release. Includes 5 Ohio regions auto-assigned by lat/lng. Icon hierarchy for Featured, Professional, Home Haunt, and Free listings. Smart clustering, mobile-first bottom sheet UI, dark themed maps. Works with GeoDirectory free using categories. Two shortcodes available.

entries.summary: Added category mapping system in admin
entries.notes: New admin page at OHA Map > Category Mapping. Allows mapping existing GeoDirectory category slugs to listing types. Supports comma-separated multiple slugs per type. No need to change existing categories in GeoDirectory.

entries.summary: Added custom icon image upload system
entries.notes: New admin page at OHA Map > Custom Icons. Upload PNG icons to replace default colored circles. Uses WordPress media library. Icons stored in options table. Recommended 32x32px PNG.

entries.summary: Added unlimited custom listing types
entries.notes: Users can add custom types beyond the 4 defaults in Category Mapping page. Each custom type gets own filter toggle, icon settings, and category mapping. Examples: Escape Rooms, Haunted Trails, Seasonal Events.

entries.summary: Fixed syntax error in admin class file
entries.notes: Removed stray PHP closing tag on line 665. Added proper render_regions_page method declaration. Error caused plugin activation failure.

entries.summary: Updated plugin folder structure
entries.notes: New structure uses versioned outer folder with clean inner folder. Allows version tracking while keeping WordPress folder name clean. Includes devlog.json in root.

entries.summary: Created comprehensive documentation
entries.notes: Documentation includes setup guides for GeoDirectory free, category mapping instructions, changelog, and folder structure explanation. Total 12 documentation files included.

entries.summary: Added Google Maps support with API key option
entries.notes: New map provider setting in admin. Choose Leaflet (free) or Google Maps (requires API key). Both support dark theme. Fixes blank map issue for users whose hosting blocks Leaflet tile servers.

entries.summary: Rewrote JavaScript to support dual map providers
entries.notes: JavaScript detects map provider and initializes correct library. Supports Leaflet with tile layers or Google Maps with styled maps. Markers, clustering, and features work on both providers.

entries.summary: Fixed blank Leaflet map issue
entries.notes: Issue caused by tile server blocks or CORS problems. Added error messaging. Users can switch to Google Maps if Leaflet tiles blocked by hosting provider.

entries.summary: Fixed all listings missing from map -- GeoDirectory stores coords in custom table not wp_postmeta
entries.notes: Root cause: plugin used get_post_meta() and meta_query for latitude/longitude, which always returns empty for GeoDirectory fields. GD stores all listing data in wp_geodir_gd_place_detail (joined table), not wp_postmeta. Rewrote get_listings() to use a direct SQL JOIN: SELECT p.ID, p.post_title, pd.* FROM wp_posts p INNER JOIN detail_table pd ON pd.post_id = p.ID. Using pd.* avoids failures when optional column names differ from defaults.

entries.summary: Fixed all non-featured maps showing blank -- shortcode type='all' was filtering out every listing
entries.notes: Shortcode defaults to type='all'. PHP get_listings() was treating 'all' as a literal type name and filtering out everything since no listing has type 'all'. Only shortcodes with type='featured' worked. Fixed by treating 'all' and empty string as no filter: if ($type && $type !== 'all' && $listing_type !== $type).

entries.summary: Fixed AJAX returning parsererror despite valid data -- UTF-8 BOM in PHP files corrupted JSON output
entries.notes: PowerShell file edits using System.Text.Encoding.UTF8 write a UTF-8 BOM at the start of files. PHP outputs the BOM before any content, breaking jQuery JSON parsing (statusText: parsererror). AJAX response contained full listing data but jQuery discarded it. Fixed by stripping BOMs from all PHP files using WriteAllBytes with bytes[3..] before packaging the zip.

entries.summary: Added configurable GeoDirectory field name mapping in admin Settings
entries.notes: Some sites use non-standard GeoDirectory column names (e.g. attraction_phone_number instead of phone). Added GeoDirectory Field Mapping section in Settings page with inputs for post_type, lat_field, lng_field, phone_field, email_field, website_field. Stored in oha_map_fields option. Defaults to standard GD column names.

entries.summary: Added Diagnostics admin page for live debugging of GeoDirectory data and AJAX responses
entries.notes: New submenu at OHA Map > Diagnostics. Shows: GD active status, detail table name and existence, all column names, 15-row coordinate sample, and live AJAX test button. Used to identify that SQL was crashing due to missing pd.phone and pd.website columns on this site.

entries.summary: Added GeoDirectory category icon support as fallback marker icon
entries.notes: Listing data now includes gd_icon_url field. Reads ct_cat_icon term meta from the listing's default GeoDirectory category. Supports both attachment ID and relative src path formats. JS icon priority: (1) custom icon from OHA Map > Custom Icons, (2) GD category icon, (3) colored circle SVG.

entries.summary: Fixed admin Settings page outputting literal PHP code as visible HTML text
entries.notes: The line $fields = self::get_field_settings(); was placed inside the HTML output block (after the PHP closing tag ?>) instead of inside the PHP section. This caused the line to render as visible text on the Settings page and made all field mapping inputs empty. Moved the variable assignment to the PHP section before the HTML begins.

entries.summary: Added Requires Plugins: geodirectory header (WP 6.5+ dependency declaration)
entries.notes: WordPress 6.5 introduced the Requires Plugins header for declaring plugin dependencies. When GeoDirectory is not active, WordPress will show a dependency warning before allowing this plugin to activate.

entries.summary: Migrated map engine from Leaflet to MapLibre GL JS v4 (WebGL)
entries.notes: Complete frontend rewrite replacing Leaflet/Google Maps with MapLibre GL JS v4 (open-source BSD-2-Clause fork of Mapbox GL JS). WebGL GPU rendering delivers 60fps smooth pan/zoom on mobile. Removed all Leaflet and Google Maps script/style enqueues. Added MapLibre CDN (maplibre-gl@4) CSS and JS. All PHP data logic (class-oha-map-data.php, class-oha-map-regions.php) preserved intact.

entries.summary: Added MapTiler tile provider with admin API key and style settings
entries.notes: New MapTiler settings section in admin Settings page. Fields: API Key (oha_map_maptiler option), Map Style dropdown (Basic Dark default, Bright, Satellite, Custom URL), Custom Style URL (shown when Custom selected). get_tile_style_url() builds: https://api.maptiler.com/maps/{style}/style.json?key={key}. Falls back to OpenFreeMap dark tiles (https://tiles.openfreemap.org/styles/dark) when no API key is set. Zero JS dependency on Leaflet tile servers.

entries.summary: Added precise Ohio region fills with data-driven GeoJSON expressions
entries.notes: Added regions_to_geojson() static method to class-oha-map-regions.php. Converts PHP [lat,lng] polygon arrays to a GeoJSON FeatureCollection with correct [lng,lat] coordinate flip and closed rings. MapLibre region-fills layer uses data-driven fill-color from feature properties. Selected region shows 25% opacity fill; unselected regions show 4% ambient fill. Separate region-fills-selected and region-fills-hover layers with filter expressions for reactive highlighting without full re-render. region-labels layer hides at zoom > 9.

entries.summary: Added admin Region Colors page with per-region fill and outline color pickers
entries.notes: New submenu page OHA Map > Region Colors. Color picker inputs for fill color and outline color for each of the 7 Ohio regions. Stored in oha_map_region_colors option as associative array keyed by region slug. Default colors are Halloween-themed: Northwest=pumpkin orange (#ff6b35), Northeast=haunted purple (#9d4edd), Central=blood red (#c0392b), East=eerie green (#27ae60), West=amber (#e67e22), Southwest=deep purple (#8e44ad), Southeast=dark orange (#d35400). Colors pass through regions_to_geojson() as GeoJSON feature properties.

entries.summary: Added Events for GeoDirectory integration as toggleable map layer
entries.notes: New get_events() and ajax_get_events() methods in class-oha-map-data.php. Detects Events for GeoDirectory by checking wp_geodir_gd_event_detail table existence before querying. SQL JOINs wp_posts + wp_geodir_gd_event_detail + wp_geodir_event_schedule, filtering to end_date >= CURDATE() to show only upcoming/active events. Returns: id, title, lat, lng, start_date, end_date, start_time, end_time, all_day, address, permalink, thumbnail, region. Applies oha_map_events filter hook for extensibility. Registered wp_ajax_oha_get_map_events and wp_ajax_nopriv_oha_get_map_events actions.

entries.summary: Added Events map layer with separate source, clustering, and layer toggles
entries.notes: Separate events GeoJSON source with MapLibre clustering. events-clusters circle layer (teal #00b4d8), events-cluster-count symbol layer, events-unclustered symbol layer using icon-event SVG. Events layer toggle button added to controls (Haunts / Events layer pills). setLayerVisibility() toggles MapLibre layout visibility for entire layer group. showEventsByDefault admin setting controls initial visibility state on page load.

entries.summary: Added admin Events Layer settings section
entries.notes: New Events Layer section in admin Settings page. Fields: Enable Events Layer toggle (oha_map_events[enabled]), Show Events by Default on page load toggle (oha_map_events[show_by_default]), Layer button label text. get_events_settings() getter method returns array with enabled, show_by_default, label keys.

entries.summary: Added 5 custom SVG marker icons for listing types and events
entries.notes: Created assets/images/icons/ directory with 5 hand-crafted Halloween-themed SVG icons. icon-featured.svg: crowned skull with radial gold gradient and glow filter. icon-professional.svg: haunted house silhouette with glowing windows, chimney, crescent moon. icon-home-haunt.svg: friendly ghost with radial purple gradient, eye shine, wavy skirt. icon-free.svg: tombstone with RIP text, cross, grass base. icon-event.svg: calendar with teal gradient and skull on highlighted day. Icons loaded with map.loadImage() via Promise.all() before layers are added to avoid race conditions. Custom admin-uploaded icons override defaults per-type.

entries.summary: Added data-driven icon sizing and sort-key for featured haunt priority
entries.notes: MapLibre symbol layers use data-driven expressions for icon-image (['get','markerIcon']), icon-size (['get','iconSize']), and symbol-sort-key (['get','sortKey']). Sort key values: featured=100, professional=50, home_haunt=30, free=10. Featured markers always render above all other types. Icon sizes: featured=0.72, professional=0.60, home_haunt=0.52, free=0.46. icon-allow-overlap: true ensures all markers always visible.

entries.summary: Added admin Card Fields page for configurable listing card content
entries.notes: New submenu page OHA Map > Card Fields. Checkbox list of available card sections: Thumbnail Image, Listing Type Badge, Haunt Status Badge (Open/Seasonal/Closed), Address, Phone Number, Website Link, Email Address, View Details Button, Upcoming Events Section, Short Description. Stored in oha_map_card_fields option. get_card_fields() getter. buildHauntCardHTML() in JS conditionally renders each section based on the option. Includes nearby events matching by ±0.15 degree proximity to listing coordinates.

entries.summary: Replaced Leaflet bottom sheet with Google Maps-style slide-up panel
entries.notes: New .oha-bottom-sheet structure: .oha-bottom-sheet-overlay (scrim) + .oha-bottom-sheet-panel (slide-up panel). CSS: translateY(100%) to translateY(0) transition at 0.32s cubic-bezier, will-change: transform for GPU compositing. Drag handle bar (36x4px, centered, rounded). Swipe-to-dismiss: touch delta > 80px triggers hide with panel animating back down. Body scroll lock (overflow:hidden on body) while panel is open. safe-area-inset-bottom respected for iPhone notch/home bar. Card sections: thumbnail (16:9 aspect ratio), type badge row, status badge, info grid with address/phone/website/email, upcoming events subsection, CTA view details button.

entries.summary: Rewrote CSS from Leaflet overrides to MapLibre container and enhanced dark theme
entries.notes: Complete CSS rewrite (~844 lines). Replaced all .leaflet-* and .marker-cluster DOM class overrides with MapLibre equivalents. CSS variables: --oha-bg-dark, --oha-bg-card, --oha-bg-controls, --oha-event. Badge color system: featured=gold, professional=orange, home_haunt=purple, event=teal, status open=green/seasonal=amber/closed=red. Layer toggle pills with active state per layer type. Mobile: horizontal scroll region pills (overflow-x auto, nowrap), safe area insets. Results counter positioned at bottom-center on mobile via translateX(-50%).

entries.summary: Rewrote shortcode HTML for MapLibre, layer toggles, and inline SVG controls
entries.notes: Updated class-oha-map-shortcode.php: added Haunts / Events layer toggle buttons to controls section using inline SVG icons (removed dashicons dependency). Rebuilt bottom sheet HTML with .oha-bottom-sheet-overlay and .oha-bottom-sheet-panel structure. Added aria attributes for accessibility. Added 'Other/free' type filter checkbox. Gets events config from OHA_Map_Admin::get_events_settings() to conditionally render events toggle.

entries.summary: Fixed broken brace nesting in save_settings() that prevented fields option from saving
entries.notes: In v1.2.0, the if (isset($_POST['clustering'])) block was missing its closing brace, causing the if (isset($_POST['fields'])) block (GeoDirectory field mapping) to be nested inside it. This meant the fields option only saved when the clustering checkbox was also present in the POST data. Fixed by restructuring all save blocks in class-oha-map-admin.php with correct independent braces.

entries.summary: v2.0.0 packaged as oha-modern-map-v2.0.0.zip with forward-slash paths verified
entries.notes: Packaged using PowerShell ZipFile::Open() + CreateEntryFromFile() with .Replace('\','/') on all entry names. Verified 18 files all use forward-slash paths with unzip -l (no Windows backslash paths that break WordPress plugin install). v1.2.0 backed up as oha-modern-map-v1.2.0.zip.bak before overwrite. All PHP files verified BOM-free before zipping.

entries.summary: Added Convention Mode — indoor floor plan map for OHA conventions
entries.notes: New [oha_convention_map] and [oha_convention_directory] shortcodes. MapLibre GL JS 'type: image' source renders uploaded floorplan images in a fake [0,0]→[1,1] coordinate space with no geographic tiles. Booth positions stored as X/Y percentages, converted to [lng,lat] coordinates client-side. Full MapLibre layer stack: booth-hitzone (wide tap target), booth-bg (circle per type color), booth-icon (symbol), booth-label (at zoom ≥10). Separate oha-convention-map.js and oha-convention.css assets. New AJAX action oha_get_convention_booths registered.

entries.summary: Added oha_booth custom post type with meta boxes for booth location, type, and details
entries.notes: New CPT oha_booth (class-oha-convention-data.php). Post title = booth display name. Meta boxes: Booth Location and Type (number, type dropdown, floor selector, X/Y % position, W/H % size, status, custom color), and Booth Details (hours, contact, website, GeoDirectory vendor ID). CPT appears under OHA Map admin menu (show_in_menu: oha-modern-map). Supports: title, thumbnail, editor.

entries.summary: Added 8 booth types with theme-matched SVG icons
entries.notes: Types: vendor (orange store), food (golden cauldron), restroom (male/female figures), class (purple scroll/book), stage (red curtains/spotlight), info (green info circle), exit (dark door with running figure), general (pin drop). SVG icons created in assets/images/icons/ as conv-{type}.svg. Icons loaded via Promise.all(map.loadImage()) with canvas-drawn colored circle fallback. Data-driven icon-image expression on booth-icon layer.

entries.summary: Added multi-floor support with floor switcher pills
entries.notes: Convention settings store an array of floors: {id, label, image_id, image_url, bg_color}. switchFloor() removes the previous raster image source and adds the new one. Background color updates via setPaintProperty. Floor selector pills rendered only when floor count > 1. Each booth has a floor meta field; applyFilters() shows only booths matching the active floor. Floors managed via OHA Map > Convention Mode admin page.

entries.summary: Added deep linking support for booths and vendors (?oha_booth=217, ?oha_vendor=slug)
entries.notes: checkDeepLink() reads URLSearchParams on page load. ?oha_booth=217 finds booth by number field, switches to correct floor if needed, calls flyToBooth() and showBoothCard(). ?oha_vendor=slug finds booth by vendor_id match. Both auto-open the bottom sheet card. Useful for linking directly to a specific vendor's booth from GeoDirectory listing or email campaigns.

entries.summary: Added optional GeoDirectory vendor linkage for booths
entries.notes: Booth meta field _booth_vendor_id stores GeoDirectory post ID. When set and GeoDirectory active, get_booths() calls geodir_get_post_info($vendor_id) to pull vendor_name, vendor_desc, and vendor_logo from the GD listing into the booth data. Convention map bottom sheet card and directory cards display vendor branding if linked. Linkage is optional — booths work without it.

entries.summary: Added Convention Mode admin page (OHA Map > Convention Mode)
entries.notes: New submenu page with: Enable/disable toggle, event name/dates/venue fields, per-floor config (label, floorplan image upload via WP media library, background color picker). Floor rows are dynamically addable with JS. Shortcode reference table included. Links to oha_booth post list and add-new screens. Settings stored in oha_convention_settings option. Added oha_convention_settings to activation defaults.

entries.summary: Added [oha_convention_directory] shortcode for text-based booth listings
entries.notes: Standalone searchable card grid of all booths. Attributes: floor (filter by floor, 0=all), type (filter by type), columns (1-6, default 3), class (extra CSS). Cards show: thumbnail or vendor logo, booth number, name, type badge, hours, website link. Client-side JS search filters by title and number. No map required — can be embedded in a separate page or tab. Fully responsive grid.

entries.summary: v2.1.0 packaged as oha-modern-map-v2.1.0.zip
entries.notes: Added files: includes/class-oha-convention-data.php, includes/class-oha-convention-shortcode.php, assets/js/oha-convention-map.js, assets/css/oha-convention.css, assets/images/icons/conv-{vendor,food,restroom,class,stage,info,exit,general}.svg. Modified files: oha-modern-map.php (version 2.1.0, convention class includes, AJAX hooks, CSS/JS enqueues, activation defaults), includes/class-oha-map-admin.php (Convention Mode submenu + render/save methods). All existing haunt map features preserved without changes.

entries.summary: Added visual Booth Placement admin tool (OHA Map > Booth Placement)
entries.notes: New admin page renders the floor plan image with DOM-overlay booth pins. Click anywhere on the image to place a new booth; drag existing pins to reposition. Panel on the right shows booth form fields: number, vendor search, type, status, hours, color, year. Pins are color-coded by type. Save and Delete buttons call AJAX handlers. Touch drag support included (touchstart/touchmove/touchend). Data config output by PHP render_placement_page() as an inline ohaPlacementConfig JS object.

entries.summary: Added vendor hub integration to booth placement via searchable type-ahead dropdown
entries.notes: New AJAX handler ajax_get_vendor_hub_list() searches vendor_application CPT posts where _oha_status is Paid or Agreement Signed. Returns {id, name, status, logo} per result. Placement tool shows a live search field; selecting a vendor fills _booth_vendor_hub_id on the booth post and shows company name + color-coded status badge. get_booths() now checks _booth_vendor_hub_id first (vendor_application meta) before falling back to GeoDirectory linkage.

entries.summary: Added year-to-year convention support with _booth_year meta and active_year setting
entries.notes: All booth posts now store a _booth_year meta field (defaults to active_year from convention settings). get_booths() filters by _booth_year so only the active year's booths appear on the front end and in the placement tool. Convention Settings page has a new Convention Year text field (active_year) saved to oha_convention_settings. Changing active_year switches the entire view without deleting old booths.

entries.summary: Added Clone Booth Positions to New Year in Convention Settings admin page
entries.notes: New section below Floor Plans in Convention Settings. Enter a target year and click Clone -- calls ajax_clone_year_layout() which duplicates all booth posts from the active year to the new year. Clones copy: title, number, type, floor, x, y, width, height, color, status (reset to tbd). Cleared on clones: _booth_vendor_hub_id, _booth_vendor_id, hours, contact, website. Returns count of cloned posts. After cloning, admin manually updates Convention Year field and reassigns vendors in Booth Placement.

entries.summary: Added ajax_save_booth_placement and ajax_delete_booth_placement AJAX handlers
entries.notes: ajax_save_booth_placement() creates (booth_id=0) or updates existing oha_booth posts from the placement tool. Saves all meta fields and returns the full booth data array for immediate pin rendering. ajax_delete_booth_placement() calls wp_trash_post(). Both require manage_options capability and verify oha_map_nonce. Registered as wp_ajax_ (admin only) in oha-modern-map.php.

entries.summary: v2.2.0 packaged as modern-map-oha-v2.2.0.zip
entries.notes: New files: assets/js/admin-placement.js, assets/css/admin-placement.css. Modified files: includes/class-oha-convention-data.php (booth_year, vendor_hub_id, 4 new AJAX methods), includes/class-oha-map-admin.php (active_year field, clone year section, Booth Placement submenu + render_placement_page), oha-modern-map.php (version 2.2.0, 4 new AJAX registrations, placement asset enqueue). Packaging: ZipFile::Open() + CreateEntryFromFile() with forward-slash paths, BOM check on all PHP files.

entries.summary: Added mobile='true' attribute to [oha_convention_map] for full-screen app map experience
entries.notes: New mobile attribute on [oha_convention_map] shortcode. When mobile=true: no controls bar; map fills full content area height (calc(100dvh - var(--oha-mobile-ui-offset, 110px))); touch-action:none on map container to contain pinch-zoom within the map frame. Use --oha-mobile-ui-offset CSS variable (default 110px) to account for PWA header + bottom nav height.

entries.summary: Added floating filters pill and bottom-sheet filter panel for mobile mode
entries.notes: Replaces the bulky controls bar with a dark navy floating pill (top-left) showing 'Filters' and an active-filter count badge. Tapping opens a slide-up bottom sheet with floor tabs (if multiple floors) and type filter pills. Sheet dismisses via Done button, overlay tap, or swipe-down gesture. All filter state syncs with the map in real time.

entries.summary: Added floating search bar and map/list view toggle pill for mobile mode
entries.notes: Search icon button (top-right) toggles a full-width search bar that overlays the map top. Live search filters booths as user types. A floating 'List View' pill (bottom-center) toggles between exclusive map view and list view -- not side-by-side. List view has its own topbar with Map/Filters buttons. Switching from list to map via tapping a booth or the Map button is animated. Booth card (bottom sheet) always triggers a map-view switch first.

entries.summary: v2.3.0 packaged as modern-map-oha-v2.3.0.zip
entries.notes: Modified files: includes/class-oha-convention-shortcode.php (mobile attribute, new mobile HTML branch, same JS config + mobile:true flag), assets/css/oha-convention.css (appended mobile mode styles section), assets/js/oha-convention-map.js (isMobile/listViewActive constructor props, initMobileUI(), openFilterSheet/closeFilterSheet, showListView/showMapView, updateFilterBadge, flyToBooth/showBoothCard mobile guard), oha-modern-map.php (version 2.3.0). All existing non-mobile shortcode output and JS paths completely unchanged.

entries.summary: Fixed mobile map stuck on loading by adding 100vh fallback for browsers without dvh support
entries.notes: Added height: calc(100vh - ...) fallback before the dvh line in .oha-conv-mobile. Without this, browsers lacking dvh support computed a 0 height on the wrapper, causing MapLibre to init with 0 height and never firing the load event.

entries.summary: Fixed mobile map layout timing by calling map.resize() 50ms after MapLibre init
entries.notes: Added setTimeout map.resize() call after new maplibregl.Map() when isMobile is true. Also added window resize handler. This ensures MapLibre fills the container even if CSS flex layout has not fully resolved at init time.

entries.summary: Fixed filter sheet and bottom sheet slide-up animations clipped by overflow:hidden on wrapper
entries.notes: Removed overflow:hidden from .oha-conv-mobile. The filter sheet panel and bottom sheet panel start at translateY(100%) and slide up from below. overflow:hidden clipped them invisibly. Removing it is safe because all overlay elements are position:absolute and do not affect document scroll.

entries.summary: Fixed boot() to check maplibregl.Map exists before init to handle partial CDN script load
entries.notes: A partially-executed CDN script passes typeof maplibregl !== 'undefined' but Map constructor is not yet defined. Added check: typeof maplibregl.Map !== 'function'. This prevents a silent TypeError that left the spinner running.

entries.summary: Fixed mobile map height: set explicit px height on wrapper and map-area before MapLibre init
entries.notes: Moved height calculation to before new maplibregl.Map() so MapLibre always gets a non-zero container. Also added map.resize() call at end of load callback chain and window resize handler.

entries.summary: Fixed floor plan image invisible: addLayer beforeId 'background' rendered image behind background
entries.notes: Removed the 'background' beforeId argument from addLayer for floorplan-raster. MapLibre addLayer(layer, beforeId) inserts BEFORE the specified layer (visually underneath it). Without beforeId the layer is added on top of background, making the floor plan visible.

entries.summary: Added 15s spinner timeout safeguard and map error logging for easier debugging
entries.notes: If the map.on('load') callback chain stalls for any reason (icon network hang, JS error), hideLoading() is called after 15s so the map is usable. map.on('error') logs to console with a clear prefix.

entries.summary: Fixed haunt map and convention map showing no markers by updating loadImage to MapLibre v4 Promise API
entries.notes: Root cause: MapLibre GL JS v4 removed the callback form of map.loadImage(url, callback). The callback was never invoked, so the internal Promise resolve() was never called, Promise.all hung forever, and loadHaunts/booth loading was never reached. Both oha-modern-map.js and oha-convention-map.js updated to use the v4 Promise API: map.loadImage(url).then(response => { img = response.data }).catch(() => { fallback }). Affects all haunt markers and all convention booth icons.

entries.summary: Replaced 7 bounding-box regions with 5 county-accurate polygon regions (NW, NE, Central, SW, SE)
entries.notes: Previous 7-region system used crude axis-aligned rectangles causing awkward map views. New 5 regions (Northwest 20 counties, Northeast 16, Central 14, Southwest 21, Southeast 17) use polygon vertices tracing actual Ohio county PLSS grid lines. Out-of-state haunts fall back to nearest region centroid via Euclidean distance instead of being dropped.

entries.summary: Region selection uses fitBounds() for dynamic viewport-aware zoom on all screen sizes
entries.notes: Replaced fixed flyTo() + zoom integer with map.fitBounds([[west_lng, south_lat], [east_lng, north_lat]], {padding, speed}). Padding is 20px on mobile (<640px) and 60px on desktop. Each region has explicit bounds in PHP stored as [[south_lat, west_lng], [north_lat, east_lng]] and converted to MapLibre order in regions_to_geojson(). All-Ohio reset uses fitBounds([[-84.82,38.38],[-80.52,41.98]]).

entries.summary: Added Ohio state outline GeoJSON layer to visually distinguish Ohio from surrounding states
entries.notes: New get_ohio_outline_geojson() method in OHA_Map_Regions returns a simplified ~28-point Ohio state boundary polygon as a GeoJSON Feature (coordinates in [lng,lat] order for GeoJSON). Passed to JS as ohaMapSettings.ohioOutline. addRegionLayers() adds source 'ohio-outline' and layer 'ohio-state-outline' (line type, orange #ff6b35, 2.5px, 80% opacity) after existing region fill layers.

entries.summary: Added mobile floating filter pill with slide-up sheet on haunt map
entries.notes: Below 640px, the desktop controls bar is hidden and a floating pill bar appears at bottom of map with a Filters pill (shows active filter count badge) and a reset pill. Tapping the pill opens a slide-up sheet containing region tabs, type toggles, and haunt count. CSS media queries handle show/hide automatically. Pattern matches the convention map mobile UI. Pill badge shows count of active filters (region + type narrowing).

entries.summary: Added region info slide-up panel with population, highlights, and Explore Haunts button
entries.notes: Clicking a region fill polygon (not a haunt marker) opens a bottom sheet showing the region name, estimated population, description, and up to 4 highlight locations. An Explore Haunts button closes the panel and filters haunts to that region. Content is admin-configurable via the new Region Info admin page (OHA Map > Region Info), stored in oha_map_region_info WP option. JS checks queryRenderedFeatures for haunt markers before opening to prevent conflict.

entries.summary: Region color defaults updated for 5 regions; added Region Info admin page
entries.notes: oha_map_region_colors defaults trimmed from 7 to 5 slugs (removed east and west). New Region Info submenu page added under OHA Map admin menu. New get_region_info() and get_default_region_info() static methods added to OHA_Map_Admin. regionInfo and ohioOutline keys added to wp_localize_script for oha-modern-map.

entries.summary: Fixed region info panel never opening: $wrapper was undefined in addRegionLayers click handler
entries.notes: addRegionLayers(map, mapId) has no $wrapper parameter. The click handler on region-fills called showRegionInfoPanel($wrapper, slug) where $wrapper was undefined, silently throwing a JS error. Fixed by deriving $wrapper from mapId: $('#' + mapId).

entries.summary: Fixed region zoom: bounds from ohaMapSettings.regions were in PHP [lat,lng] order, not MapLibre [lng,lat] order
entries.notes: PHP stores region bounds as [[south_lat, west_lng], [north_lat, east_lng]]. MapLibre fitBounds() expects [[west_lng, south_lat], [east_lng, north_lat]]. getRegionData() was returning the raw PHP array, causing fitBounds to receive swapped coordinates and zoom to the wrong location. Fixed by swapping both pairs in getRegionData() when reading from ohaMapSettings.regions.

entries.summary: Fixed old 7-region polygons showing: stale oha_map_regions DB option overrode new 5-region defaults
entries.notes: get_regions() called get_option('oha_map_regions', defaults). If the option was saved when 7 regions existed (slugs east/west), it returned old data and the new 5-region polygons were never used. Fixed by checking for isset($regions['east']) || isset($regions['west']) and falling back to defaults if found. Existing custom region overrides without east/west keys continue to work.

entries.summary: Added vendor Save/Remove favorites button to booth detail card (vendor type only)
entries.notes: Writes to localStorage oha_favorite_vendors, same key used by PWA [oha_favorite_vendors] shortcode. Stored data: {id, name, logo, booth}. Button reflects saved state on card open. _currentBoothCard stored on instance for click handler.

entries.summary: Added vendorHubId and description to GeoJSON booth properties
entries.notes: vendorHubId was missing from boothsToGeoJSON so map-click cards could not read vendor hub ID for favorites. description field now passed from PHP get_booths() post_content.

entries.summary: Replaced emoji HTML entities in booth card info rows with inline SVG icons
entries.notes: clock emoji (⏰) and person emoji (👤) replaced with inline SVG to comply with no-emojis rule in CLAUDE.md.

entries.summary: Added booth description from post_content; non-vendor booths can show details via WP editor
entries.notes: get_booths() now reads post_content (wp_strip_all_tags, 40 words) into description field. showBoothCard uses description || vendorDesc.

entries.summary: Floor switching moved to persistent floating pills on mobile map; removed from filter sheet
entries.notes: Two pill buttons float top-left below the filter pill (.oha-mob-floor-bar). Only shown when floors > 1. Removed floor section from filter sheet since always visible now.

entries.summary: Added food_truck booth type with amber color distinct from food type
entries.notes: Key: food_truck, label: Food Truck, color: #e67e22. Icon reuses conv-food.svg. Added to TYPE_COLORS and TYPE_ICONS in JS and all three PHP helper methods.

entries.summary: Reduced booth pin circle radius and hitzone to reduce overlap on dense floor plans
entries.notes: circle-radius changed from 5/9/14 to 3/5/7 at zoom 6/12/18. hitzone radius 20px to 14px. Icon size scaled down to match. All now derived from pinSize setting.

entries.summary: Added Booth Pin Size setting in Convention Settings admin (range 2-20, default 5)
entries.notes: Stored as pin_size in oha_convention_settings. Passed to JS as config.pinSize. addBoothLayers computes hitzone, r6, r18, icon sizes proportionally from this base value.

entries.summary: Floor plan image URLs include attachment modified-time as cache-bust param
entries.notes: ?v=UNIX_TIMESTAMP appended using get_post_modified_time on image_id at render time. Changes automatically when admin replaces the floor plan image in WordPress Media. Busts browser, CDN, and PWA service worker cache.

entries.summary: Fix vendor_hub_id never saved to booth meta due to wrong POST key in both JS save paths
entries.notes: admin-placement.js had two $.post calls sending vendor_id instead of vendor_hub_id. PHP save_booth_placement reads [vendor_hub_id] so the value was always 0, meaning _booth_vendor_hub_id was never written. This broke the Find Booth link in PWA vendor cards and the oha_vendor deep-link on the map. After installing this fix, re-save each vendor booth in Booth Placement admin to populate _booth_vendor_hub_id for existing booths.

entries.summary: Add iOS-safe body scroll lock in mobile map boot to keep overlays in place
entries.notes: Sets position:fixed+top on body when isMobile; restores on pagehide. CSS class oha-map-page-active added to html and body.

entries.summary: Floor plan pins now visible at load via fitBounds before checkDeepLink
entries.notes: map.fitBounds([[0,0],[1,1]]) called in loadBooths callback so pins render at the right scale before deep link zoom fires.

entries.summary: flyToBooth now uses configurable deepLinkZoom instead of hardcoded zoom 14
entries.notes: config.deepLinkZoom passed from shortcode PHP; default 10. Zoom 14 in [0,1] space was 64x too close.

entries.summary: Admin setting for deep link zoom level added to Convention Settings page
entries.notes: Range 6-16, default 10. Saved in oha_convention_settings and passed as deepLinkZoom in both mobile and standard shortcode JS configs.

entries.summary: get_booths now returns booths without a _booth_year meta so legacy booths appear on map
entries.notes: Meta query uses OR relation: year matches active_year OR _booth_year NOT EXISTS. Booths created before year tracking was added were invisible.

entries.summary: X/Y position inputs now accept 2 decimal places (step changed from 0.1 to 0.01)
entries.notes: booth_x and booth_y inputs in render_location_meta_box had step=0.1 which blocked saving values like 80.38 stored by the placement tool.

entries.summary: Floor plan image no longer renders on top of booth pins when switching floors
entries.notes: loadFloor() now passes beforeId=booth-hitzone when adding floorplan-raster so the raster layer is always below booth layers. On initial load booth layers do not exist yet so beforeId is undefined (correct). On floor switches the raster was being appended to the top of the layer stack covering all pins.

entries.summary: Remove overflow:hidden from body scroll lock so filter sheet can animate in from below
entries.notes: body.oha-map-page-active had overflow:hidden which clipped the filter sheet panel at the body bottom edge during its slide-up animation. The panel starts at translateY(100%) = below the body boundary, and overflow:hidden prevented it from entering view. position:fixed on body already prevents scroll; overflow:hidden is only needed on html.

entries.summary: List view button changed to position:fixed so it stays visible above PWA nav bar
entries.notes: position:absolute inside map area means the button can end up behind the PWA nav bar if any page header pushes the map wrapper down. Changed to position:fixed with bottom:calc(--oha-mobile-ui-offset + 20px) and z-index:200 so it is always viewport-relative and above the nav bar.

entries.summary: Remove filter button from mobile convention map; floor maps now top position
entries.notes: Filter pill removed from top-left. Floor switcher bar stays at same absolute position. Filter sheet HTML remains in DOM but is no longer triggerable.

entries.summary: List View toggle moved to top-left pill, replaces old bottom-center button
entries.notes: Button now position:absolute top:14px left:14px z-index:30, above list view overlay (z-index:25). Old fixed bottom-center button removed.

entries.summary: List View toggle now switches bidirectionally between list and map view
entries.notes: Single button replaces separate List pill and Map button. Shows List View icon/text in map mode, Map View icon/text in list mode via is-list-active CSS class toggled in JS showListView/showMapView.

entries.summary: Remove filter button from list view topbar; topbar now shows only the event name centered
entries.notes: oha-mob-list-filter-btn and oha-mob-map-toggle-btn removed from list topbar HTML. Topbar uses justify-content:center now.

entries.summary: Change booth AJAX from POST to GET so PWA service worker can cache the response offline
entries.notes: ajax_get_booths now reads from  and skips nonce check (read-only public data, nopriv endpoint). JS loadBooths() changed to type:GET with no nonce param, giving a stable URL (/wp-admin/admin-ajax.php?action=oha_get_convention_booths&floor=0) that the SW caches on first online visit and serves offline.

entries.summary: Bundle MapLibre GL JS 4.7.1 locally; remove CDN dependency for offline reliability
entries.notes: Files at assets/vendor/maplibre/maplibre-gl.js and maplibre-gl.css. Enqueue updated in oha-modern-map.php to use OHA_MODERN_MAP_URL.

entries.summary: Add offline/error status bar to convention map showing cached data age or error message
entries.notes: Div .oha-conv-status-bar added after loading overlay in class-oha-convention-shortcode.php. CSS in oha-convention.css. showStatusBar() method in oha-convention-map.js. Timestamp stored in localStorage oha_conv_booth_updated.

entries.summary: Highlight selected booth pin with persistent white ring and one-shot pulse animation on deep link or tap
entries.notes: booth-selected MapLibre layer filters by id property, cleared on card dismiss. _pulsePin() creates a DOM .oha-pin-pulse element over the MapLibre canvas container. CSS in oha-convention.css. Both flyToBooth() and hideBoothCard() updated.

entries.summary: Add bottom padding to flyToBooth so pin sits above the slide-up card instead of behind it
entries.notes: Reads .oha-conv-bottom-sheet outerHeight() at fly time; falls back to 45% of map container height. padding passed to MapLibre flyTo as { top:40, bottom:sheetH, left:20, right:20 }.

entries.summary: Fix pulse animation position by firing _pulsePin after moveend instead of before flyTo
entries.notes: map.project() now runs after the fly animation completes so screen coordinates are correct. Uses map.once(moveend) callback.

entries.summary: Coach marks tutorial overlay on first visit: 3-4 steps, spotlight ring, localStorage persistence
entries.notes: Key: oha_conv_map_tutorial_v1. Suppressed on deep links. initTutorial() called after initBottomSheet().

entries.summary: Floor deep link support: ?oha_floor=ID switches floor with no booth selected
entries.notes: Handled in checkDeepLink() before booth/vendor params. Tutorial suppressed when floor param present.

entries.summary: Inline type filter chips replace slide-up filter sheet on mobile map
entries.notes: Horizontal scroll row at top:100px (54px if single floor). Classes: oha-mob-type-chip, uses oha-conv-type-all/oha-conv-type-btn for JS binding.

entries.summary: Search haystack now includes type_label so typing restroom finds restroom booths
entries.notes: applyFilters() haystack: title + number + vendor_name + type_label.

entries.summary: Removed filter sheet from mobile shortcode - was causing layout bleed and visible handle bug
entries.notes: oha-mob-filter-sheet HTML removed. openFilterSheet/closeFilterSheet methods removed. swipe handler removed.

entries.summary: Removed flyTo padding that shifted map center and broke deep link zoom positioning
entries.notes: Reverts the bottom-padding change from v2.10.2. flyTo now centers pin directly without sheet offset.

entries.summary: Tutorial tooltip bottom raised to 65px to clear PWA bottom nav bar
entries.notes: Was bottom:0 which put the card behind the nav. If nav height changes, adjust bottom value in .oha-tutorial-tooltip CSS.

entries.summary: Tutorial tooltip anchored from top:160px instead of bottom so it works on all devices
entries.notes: No longer depends on nav bar height. Centered welcome card still uses top:50% transform. max-height:calc(100dvh - 200px) prevents overflow on short screens.

entries.summary: loadFloor() now removes placeholder-dots/placeholder-grid layer before adding a new floor image
entries.notes: Placeholder dot grid (added for imageless floors) persisted on top of other floors when switching. Added to the layer cleanup block at start of loadFloor().

entries.summary: Admin floor ID generation uses max(existing IDs)+1 to prevent ID collisions after deletions
entries.notes: Previously used count(floors)+1 which could assign a duplicate ID if a floor was deleted and re-added. Now tracks maxFloorId separately from the row index counter.

entries.summary: booth-selected ring filter type mismatch fixed - was string comparison, now numeric
entries.notes: MapLibre == is type-strict. GeoJSON id property is a number but filter used String(booth.id). Changed initial filter to -1, highlight to booth.id (raw number), reset to -1.

entries.summary: Direct pin tap now activates the selected ring highlight same as deep links
entries.notes: Previously only flyToBooth (list clicks, deep links) set the ring. Pin tap click handlers now also set booth-selected filter.

entries.summary: Auto-heal duplicate floor IDs in get_settings() - writes corrected data back to DB on first load
entries.notes: Floors saved with duplicate IDs (from pre-v2.11.4 collision bug) are detected on any get_settings() call. The duplicate is renumbered to max_id+1 and persisted back via update_option. Self-heals without manual DB edits.

entries.summary: Vendor booths render as named box labels instead of circle pins
entries.notes: New booth-vendor-box symbol layer uses text-background-color with typeColor. Filters booth-bg, booth-icon, booth-label to non-vendor types only. Vendor box click handler added. Vendor type color updated to #e0f908 to match floor plan image; text-color set to #1a1a1a for readability on light background.

entries.summary: Type filter auto-switches floor when filtered type only exists on one floor
entries.notes: New _autoFloorForType() helper scans allBooths for distinct floor IDs that have the selected type. If only 1 floor has it, switchFloor() is called automatically. If multiple floors have it but current floor has none, jumps to first floor that does. Returns true if switchFloor was called so chip handler skips redundant applyFilters call.

entries.summary: Vendor booths were invisible due to text-allow-overlap:false hiding all labels on packed floor
entries.notes: Dropped text-background-color approach (unreliable in MapLibre v4). Restored booth-bg circle for all types including vendor. booth-vendor-box now uses text-halo-color with typeColor as the halo (fully supported), text-allow-overlap:true and text-ignore-placement:true so all vendor names always render. Dark text #1a1a1a on e0f908 halo.

entries.summary: Fix all pins invisible caused by text-ignore-placement breaking MapLibre symbol renderer
entries.notes: Removed text-ignore-placement:true from booth-vendor-box (was crashing symbol renderer for all layers). Added minzoom:deepLinkZoom so vendor name labels only appear when zoomed in past the configured deep link zoom level. Below that threshold the colored circle pin is the sole indicator. text-allow-overlap:true kept so all names show when zoomed in.

entries.summary: Revert booth layers to original circle pins; remove booth-vendor-box label layer
entries.notes: Removed booth-vendor-box symbol layer and all vendor-specific layer filters. Restored booth-bg, booth-icon, booth-label, and click handlers to original state (no vendor filtering). Vendor type color stays at #e0f908 and auto-floor-for-type feature stays. Vendor name label on pin (zoom 12+) restored via original booth-label step expression.

entries.summary: Retheme CSS to Kadence site palette: maroon/black cards, OHA red accents, scoped CSS vars
entries.notes: Moved CSS vars from :root to .oha-map-wrapper. All blue-navy hardcoded values replaced with global-palette vars.

entries.summary: Replace Ohio state outline with accurate 55-point polygon tracing real state borders
entries.notes: Previous outline was 27 rectangular points. New coords trace Lake Erie (Sandusky Bay dip), Ohio River curves (Gallipolis, Portsmouth, Cincinnati), PA/Indiana straight borders.

entries.summary: Region divider lines and fills fade out when zoomed past county level (zoom 9-10)
entries.notes: Uses MapLibre interpolate expressions on line-opacity and fill-opacity. State outline stays visible at all zooms.

entries.summary: Ohio state outline color changed from orange #ff6b35 to Kadence red #ad3119
entries.notes: Line width and opacity also interpolated by zoom level.

entries.summary: Clicking a blank region on the map now zooms into that region instead of opening info panel
entries.notes: Removed showRegionInfoPanel call from region-fills click handler. Now calls selectRegion() directly.

entries.summary: Cluster circle colors updated from hardcoded orange to Kadence red palette
entries.notes: Cluster colors: #ad3119 / #8a2514 / #680400. Stroke updated to match.

entries.summary: All Ohio fitBounds north bound corrected to 42.40 to include Lake Erie / PA corner
entries.notes: Previous bound was 41.98 which cut off the NE corner of Ohio at the PA border.

entries.summary: Split-screen sidebar panel shows haunts in current viewport; bidirectional pin/card hover highlight
entries.notes: Desktop-only (hidden below 900px). Populated by map.on(moveend). Panel toggle button in overlay controls. State keyed by mapId in sidebarOpen{}.

entries.summary: Initial view now uses fitBounds so Ohio always fills the viewport on any screen size
entries.notes: Replaced center+zoom constructor with bounds+fitBoundsOptions. Removed maxBounds which caused snap/off-center behavior on zoom-out.

entries.summary: Clustering disable_at_zoom admin setting was silently ignored due to wrong JS key
entries.notes: JS was reading clusterSettings.max_zoom (undefined); corrected to read disable_at_zoom || max_zoom || 14.

entries.summary: County-based region fills replace hand-drawn polygons; fetches 88 official county boundaries from Ohio state GIS
entries.notes: ArcGIS endpoint: maps.ohio.gov Ohio_County_Boundaries_Land_Only FeatureServer. Cached 7 days as transient oha_ohio_counties_v1. AJAX: oha_get_ohio_counties. JS source ohio-counties populated by loadCounties after map load.

entries.summary: County Regions admin page lets admin reassign individual counties between regions
entries.notes: Slug: oha-map-county-regions. Saves to oha_county_region_map option. Saving auto-clears county transient cache. Default 88-county map matches original polygon intent exactly.

entries.summary: Clicking a haunt pin no longer zooms the map; county-fills click handler now skips when a pin is under the cursor
entries.notes: addMapInteractions county-fills click handler was missing the queryRenderedFeatures haunt-hit guard that addRegionLayers has. Both handlers were firing on haunt clicks causing selectRegion to zoom to/from the region.

entries.summary: Ohio state outline now uses real Census TIGER boundary (300+ pts) instead of hand-drawn 55-pt polygon
entries.notes: get_ohio_state_geojson() fetches from Census TIGER State_County MapServer layer 0 where NAME=Ohio. Cached 7 days as oha_ohio_state_v1. Returned alongside county GeoJSON in ajax_get_ohio_counties response. loadCounties JS updates ohio-outline source with the real boundary. Falls back to existing hand-drawn outline if Census fetch fails.

entries.summary: Fix sidebar panel list overflow by adding min-height:0 to .oha-panel-list flex item
entries.notes: Classic flex overflow bug -- flex items default to min-height:auto so overflow-y:auto never activates. Fix: min-height:0 on .oha-panel-list. Also added overflow:hidden to .oha-map-content when sidebar open.

entries.summary: Sidebar panel replaces separate list view on desktop (>=900px)
entries.notes: On desktop the old List/Map view toggle is hidden via CSS. List button now calls toggleSidebar(). Map button closes sidebar. toggleSidebar syncs view button active state. Mobile list view unchanged.

entries.summary: Bottom sheet card uses side-by-side layout on tablet/desktop (>=640px)
entries.notes: At 640px+ .oha-popup-card becomes flex row: 220px thumbnail left column, content right. Thumbnail has gradient overlay (fade bottom on mobile, fade right on desktop). Title bumped 17->18px.

entries.summary: CTA button in haunt bottom sheet replaced with solid OHA red block button
entries.notes: .oha-popup-cta now has own styles: var(--oha-primary) solid bg, uppercase, 13px padding. No longer relying on .oha-btn-primary gradient.

entries.summary: Sidebar panel cards improved: 72px thumb, featured gold border, home-haunt purple border
entries.notes: Thumb widened from 60px to 72px. oha-type-featured gets 3px gold left border. oha-type-home_haunt gets 3px purple left border.

entries.summary: Add Adams County to county region map; was missing from default 88-county array
entries.notes: Adams County omitted alphabetically. Default assignment is southwest. Now appears in admin County Regions page.

entries.summary: Replace old polygon ray-cast region lookup with county-centroid nearest-neighbor
entries.notes: get_region_for_point() was using hand-drawn polygon polygons (same broken regions as the old visual fills). Replaced with nearest-county-centroid using get_county_centroids() (88 Ohio county approx centroids) + get_county_region_map(). Haunt filter and visual county fills now use same data source -- no more mismatch.

entries.summary: Fix overlay control icons invisible (black on black) on map
entries.notes: Theme CSS overrides fill on SVG elements. Added explicit fill:var(--oha-text-primary) and color:var(--oha-text-primary) to .oha-map-control svg in oha-modern-map.css.

entries.summary: Search box with autocomplete for haunt names and city names
entries.notes: Client-side filtering of allHaunts array; haunt click flies to pin + opens bottom sheet; city click filters + zooms; city field added to PHP get_listings() output

entries.summary: Near Me geolocation button - sorts sidebar by distance, shows distance badges on panel cards
entries.notes: Haversine formula (R=3958.8 miles); pulsing blue dot marker via MapLibre custom Marker; toggles off on second click; auto-opens sidebar on first activation

entries.summary: Favorites heart button on popup and panel cards with localStorage persistence and filter toggle
entries.notes: oha_map_favorites localStorage key stores array of haunt IDs; filter toggle btn hides non-favorites from map source and list views; heart state synced across popup + panel card simultaneously

entries.summary: View Details and View Event CTA buttons now open in same window instead of new tab
entries.notes: Removed target=_blank from oha-popup-cta in buildHauntCardHTML, buildEventCardHTML, and buildListingCard; external website links in info grid keep target=_blank

entries.summary: Raised mobile breakpoint from 640px to 767px; Samsung phones now correctly get mobile UI layout
entries.notes: Old 640px breakpoint caused Samsung landscape (800-900px CSS width) to render full desktop controls on mobile

entries.summary: Filter sheet uses visibility:hidden + transition delay to prevent Android Chrome pre-render flash
entries.notes: overflow:hidden + CSS transform alone had edge cases on Android Chrome; belt-and-suspenders with visibility

entries.summary: Type checkbox handler unified to read only from the triggering container (mobile or desktop)
entries.notes: Dual checkbox groups: reading all checked boxes across both containers caused hidden desktop boxes to override mobile unchecks

entries.summary: Near Me user location dot switched from DOM Marker to GeoJSON circle layer
entries.notes: maplibregl.Marker with custom DOM element caused WebGL layer instability on Android Chrome; GeoJSON circle stays in WebGL pipeline

entries.summary: Near Me no longer triggers sidebar toggle on mobile to avoid unwanted map resize
entries.notes: sidebar is desktop-only; calling toggleSidebar on mobile changed state without visible effect and triggered map.resize()

entries.summary: CTA button moved before info grid in popup card HTML so it is always visible above fold
entries.notes: CTA was last element in card body; bottom sheet slides up from map edge so CTA fell off screen on short viewports

entries.summary: Mobile pill bar redesigned to 2-row layout: search input row + Near Me, Filters, Saved, Reset action row
entries.notes: Previous pill bar had only Filter and Reset; search/Near Me/Favorites were inaccessible on mobile

entries.summary: Mobile map container height changed from calc(100vh-80px) to fixed 480px
entries.notes: 100vh on mobile caused overflow and layout issues; fixed height keeps map usable without full-screen mode

entries.summary: Fear level badge + filter: pull fear_level from GD, show color-coded badge on cards, add filter pills to desktop and mobile
entries.notes: Fear levels: Mild=green, Moderate=amber, Intense=red, Extreme=black/red. Values must match GD select options exactly.

entries.summary: Haunt feature tags: pull haunt_features multiselect from GD, render as pill tags on popup and panel cards
entries.notes: GD multiselect stored as comma-separated string; parse_multiselect() handles JSON/serialized/CSV formats defensively.

entries.summary: Wheelchair accessible badge + filter toggle on desktop and mobile controls
entries.notes: Checks wheelchair_accessible field for yes/true/1 to handle varied GD select option values.

entries.summary: Indoor/Outdoor badge on popup cards pulled from indoor_outdoor GD field
entries.notes: Display only, not filterable in v2.19.0 - can add filter later if needed.

entries.summary: activeFilters extended with fearLevel and accessible; applyFilters and mobile badge count updated
entries.notes: Mobile filter badge count now reflects 4 filter dimensions: region, type, fear level, accessible.
